lines.t: When the thunder speaks, I listen deep within,
Whispered truth cuts through my sin.
I walk the line where light meets shade,
Following the path my Maker laid.
I bow, I yield, I hear Your call,
Your will above, my pride must fall.
Teach me, Lord, to love and stay,
In the peace of Your holy way.
The world cries loud with empty sound,
But Your quiet voice is where I’m found.
Not my will, but Yours be done,
The servant walks where walks the Son.
I bow, I yield, I hear Your call,
Your will above, my pride must fall.
Teach me, Lord, to love and stay,
In the peace of Your holy way.
Teach me, Lord, to love and stay,
In the peace of Your holy way.
The fire refines, the heart obeys,
When truth breaks chains, my soul is raised.
From dust to dawn, Your word remains,
A crown of light through all my days.
I bow, I yield, I hear Your call,
Your will above, my pride must fall.
Teach me, Lord, to love and stay,
In the peace of Your holy way.
In the peace of Your holy way.
Your voice, my guide, forever true,
Every step, I follow You.
